cohort: Pregnant women admitted to maternity wards of public hospitals in the Sidama Region, including 69 cases with PPROM and 207 controls without PPROM.
finding: Pregnancy-induced hypertension, a history of abortion, a history of cesarean section, a mid-upper arm circumference <23 cm, a history of urinary tract infection, and a hemoglobin level <11 mg/dl were identified as determinants of PPROM.
mod_finding: A history of cesarean section was found to be a determinant of PPROM.
